newerObservedMultiplierMaximum.note: Round starting at 1228 has terminal 5 X symbols. Generator remains conservatively limited to 4 by its training model.

winModel.matching: each paying symbol with total board count >=8 wins; win_match_key_list enumerates every occurrence using wirePosition
winModel.tumble: remove all winning positions in each column, preserve non-winning order at the bottom, and prepend newly generated symbols

paytableBreakpoints.resolution: for count 8..36, use the value at the greatest breakpoint <= count

deliverySettlement.continuationAccumulator: when spin_status=0, round_win_amount equals previous continuing round_win_amount plus current win_amount; otherwise it begins at current win_amount
deliverySettlement.terminalMultiplier: on the following spin_status=1 Step, round_win_amount equals the preceding accumulator multiplied by sum(numeric X values in terminal win_x_key_list), or x1 when the list is empty
deliverySettlement.roundPayout: sum round_win_amount of every Step whose spin_status==1
deliverySettlement.terminalPayRelationship: spin_status=0 iff win_amount>0; all 2852 earlier original responses satisfy it

MARY_SMALL_GAME.state: paid winning Step begins with small_game_type=0 and spin_status=0; subsequent small-game deliveries use small_game_type=1 until a terminal spin_status=1 Step
MARY_SMALL_GAME.payout: the terminal X multiplier settles the continuing accumulator

SCATTER_FREE_ROUNDS.retrigger: during Free mode, exactly 2 Scat on a segment-terminal Step adds 5 to free_spin_num

round.paidStart: POST /cp/api/v1/jungle-fruit/spin with bet_level/bet_size and raw gid 16 via body or game-id header, while no active Round exists
round.generationBoundary: Loader generates and verifies complete Rounds offline; API only claims one immutable Redis member and projects its Steps
round.deliveryBoundary: one HTTP Spin response projects exactly the next ordered Step
round.consumption: an active session consumes all remaining Deliveries from the same roundKey and may not claim another member
round.historyFinalization: write exactly one History row/detail after all Deliveries have been consumed

runtimeContract.paidSelection: SecureRandom chooses loss/win, then uniformly chooses an existing exact integer payout multiplier; atomically LPOP one member; no generation or fixture fallback
runtimeContract.integerMultiplier: exact payout/paidBet; fractional candidates excluded from Loader pools; never floor payout into a different bucket

generationConstraints.model: weighted column blocks by entry/column/exact replacement length; whole-candidate rejection
generationConstraints.scope: conservative observed bounds; not an assertion of original theoretical limits
